sections.title: New dashboard fork endpoint and its authorization
sections.rationale: The new DashboardForkResource, its route registration, and the test all implement one access-controlled action whose authorization is the key concern.

sections.title: Dashboard.fork and Widget.copy model logic
sections.rationale: These two model methods implement the data duplication the fork endpoint invokes, and they determine what data (including cross-dashboard references) is copied.
